reason: Declared fail-closed governance is not enforced at the repository merge boundary because main has no branch protection/ruleset and no required checks.
minimum_remediation: Require changes to main through pull requests.
Require Self Governance (ubuntu-latest) after canonical self-governance docs are tracked.
Prevent merge when a required check is missing, pending, or failing.
solo_maintainer_note: Do not require an approving review if that would make a solo-maintainer repository impossible to merge; enforce PR plus exact-head status checks instead.
